_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH, reconciled against the approved renders (MOP 30-day, Affordability calculator, Resale HDB vs BTO, Capital appreciation, PSF). See docs/APPROVED_BASELINE.md.

headline.use: headlines, titles, hooks, CTAs, lower thirds, counters, burned captions

body.use: captions, sub-text, descriptions, handle, fine print

type._note: Nunito Sans is installed in the repo as static instances cut from the official variable font. Poppins substitution is retired. Do not substitute.

palette._rule: NO RED ANYWHERE. One accent per scene, taken in order from accent_rotation.

layout._rule: Scene graphics bottom out ABOVE content_max_y (1000). caption_clear_zone (1016-1224) is painted flat brand bg every frame so burned captions never sit over blobs, grain or scene art. Captions centre on caption_y_factor (0.58H = 1114), inside that zone.

duration._model: hook 4s + N content scenes at 10s + recap 5s + CTA 6s, then the 5s outro is appended. Narration should cover everything up to the CTA; the outro carries its own audio.

audio._volume_note: 10 out of 100 in CapCut = linear gain 0.10. Locked. Ducking under narration is on top of this.

loudnorm._note: IG, TikTok and YouTube all normalise to roughly -14 LUFS. Doing it here means the platform does not do it unpredictably to the mix.

voiceover._source: Read directly off Kiian's ElevenLabs Text to Speech panel. Supersedes the earlier George 45/80/20 guess, which was wrong on voice, similarity and style.
voiceover.acronym_rule: hyphenate for clean read: C-P-F, A-B-S-D, T-D-S-R, P-S-F, T-O-P, H-D-B, B-T-O
voiceover._speed_note: Speed is at maximum, which compresses the rendered <break> gaps below their nominal length. audio_align's silence threshold is set low enough to still catch them.

captions_burned._note: Approved treatment: warm brown soft shadow, no hard outline, back-out pop. Centred on 0.58H.
captions_burned._offset_note: Global nudge applied to every caption. Negative = captions appear earlier. Adjust in 40ms steps if the read still leads or lags.

social_captions.voice: first person agent; 'for example' framing on illustrative figures; hook + reframe only, no point-by-point number breakdowns

outro._note: Appended to every video. Conformed to the render fps and pixel format before concat so there is no stutter at the join. Its own audio plays; the lo-fi bed fades out before it.

safe_area._note: TikTok and Reels draw their own UI over the video: caption and username along the bottom, action buttons down the right. Anything inside those bands is covered on at least one platform.
